annotations.title: Are we ahead of or behind our peers on this metric?

description: Use when the user names a public company and asks how its growth, margin, R&D or marketing spend compares with competitors. Returns the company's revenue growth, gross margin, or R&D or sales-and-marketing as a share of revenue for its latest fiscal year, each peer's, the peer median, the gap and the rank, from SEC EDGAR XBRL as filed; every excluded peer is named with the reason. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/peer-benchmark.json

metric.description: What to compare, from each company's latest 10-K: revenue_growth (revenue growth), gross_margin (gross margin), rd_intensity (R&D as a share of revenue), sm_intensity (sales and marketing as a share of revenue), ad_intensity (advertising as a share of revenue).

peers.description: 2-6 peer tickers from the same list, comma-separated, e.g. "CAG,CPB,KHC".
